description: This file defines the ConceptNameInUseException class, a custom exception in the OpenMRS API used when attempting to operate on concept names that are actively in use by observations.

classes.name: ConceptNameInUseException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating a concept name is in use, extending APIException.

methods.name: ConceptNameInUseException
methods.description: Constructors to initialize the exception with optional custom message and cause.
